name: serialize a consistent vocabulary object as a pickled dataclass
definition: Persist a vocabulary object exposing parallel word-to-index and index-to-word structures that are exact inverses of each other and equal in size to the embedding rows.
failure_mode: Inconsistent mappings, a module path that blocks unpickling, or size mismatch with the model fails structural checks.

name: set up a solver and network definition for a training run
definition: Provide valid prototxt solver and train/test network files, with the solver set to CPU mode and a capped iteration count.
failure_mode: Prototxt issues or the iteration config is wrong.

name: solve a (mixed-)integer program, incl. equality-sum constraints, for the optimal decision/verdict
definition: solve a (mixed-)integer program, incl. equality-sum constraints, for the optimal decision/verdict
failure_mode: unreadable format, wrong solver defaults, or getting the fractional part wrong fails the content check

name: solve a standard 9x9 sudoku puzzle
definition: Apply exact-solving (e.g. constraint propagation/backtracking) to fill all remaining cells such that each row, column, and 3x3 box contains distinct digits.
failure_mode: Incomplete or invalid completion fails the exact-match comparison.
